      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The edits in kernel files are purely mechanical deletions following the removal of mempool expiry and do not alter kernel library interfaces or architecture."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled 'Mempool', modifies CTxMemPool data structures in src/txmempool.cpp/h, and removes time-based eviction policy.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removing time-based eviction resolves an incentive-incompatible policy that drops mineable transactions such as low-feerate CPFP parents, while eliminating an entire index from CTxMemPool. Per the description, age-based eviction 'may drop transactions that could still be mined' and maintaining the unused `entry_time` index incurs an unnecessary memory footprint and O(log n) insertion and deletion overhead."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Deletes mempool_expiry.py and updates existing fuzz and functional test scripts to reflect the removal of expiry.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Test modifications solely follow the functional policy change rather than improving test framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp solely to log an initialization warning if the deprecated `-mempoolexpiry` flag is supplied.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "A configuration flag deprecation warning whose entire purpose is mempool configuration belongs to mempool, not utils."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "PRs whose primary subject is mempool policy belong in mempool even if they pass through validation notification hooks."
